risks.risk: Inability to meet the hard 90‑day go‑live deadline
risks.why_it_matters: Cedar Ridge Medical Group rejected our bid because our seven‑month implementation timeline missed their 90‑day clinic opening requirement. Lakeview Clinics has the same hard deadline, so a delayed rollout would likely cause the bid to be rejected.
risks.mitigation: Plan a phased, pilot‑first rollout with dedicated implementation resources, a detailed project schedule, and weekly executive checkpoints to ensure the core patient intake and billing functionality is live within 90 days.

risks.risk: Insufficient security and compliance documentation (HIPAA, encryption, audit logging)
risks.why_it_matters: Both the Halden Trust Bank and Cedar Ridge Medical Group bids were lost because the security response did not satisfy the client’s risk or regulatory teams. The new healthcare project will require HIPAA compliance, encryption, and audit logging, making a weak security package a deal‑breaker.
risks.mitigation: Include a full control‑by‑control compliance matrix, SOC 2 report, recent penetration‑test summary, BAA offering, and data‑residency statement in the base proposal; attach evidence of prior successful security audits.

conflicts.claim: A comprehensive security package drives win probability
conflicts.deciding_factor: RFP‑014 was won after rebuilding the security package (control matrix, SOC 2, pen‑test summary, data‑residency statement), whereas RFP‑005 was lost because the security response was deemed insufficient. The presence of detailed, audit‑ready security artifacts is the differentiator.
